title: The Double Diagonal Estimator: Reducing Bias in Two-Sided Marketplace Experiments
abstract: arXiv:2610.41294v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Interference between participants in two-sided marketplace experiments can severely bias conventional A/B tests. While two-sided randomization (TSR), which randomizes both supply and demand, enables estimators that mitigate this bias, existing analyses offer limited guidance on which estimator to prefer for the balanced market conditions common in practice, as they largely focus on extreme supply- or demand-constrained regimes. We introduce the Double Diagonal (DD) estimator, a novel method for interference-robust treatment effect estimation. The DD estimator contrasts the outcomes of treated-treated and control-control pairs and uses the off-diagonal interactions (treated-control and control-treated) to correct for interference-induced bias. translated_title: 双对角估计量：减少双边市场实验中的偏差
translated_abstract: 双边市场实验中参与者之间的干扰会严重偏倚传统的A/B测试。双边随机化（TSR，即同时对供给侧和需求侧进行随机化）使得能够使用缓解这种偏差的估计量，但现有分析主要聚焦于极端的供给侧或需求侧受限情形，对于实践中常见的均衡市场条件下应优先选用哪种估计量提供的指导有限。我们提出了双对角（DD）估计量，这是一种用于抗干扰处理效应估计的新方法。DD估计量通过对比“处理-处理”对与“控制-控制”对的结果，并利用非对角交互（处理-控制与控制-处理）来校正由干扰引起的偏差。我们在一个简化的平均场市场模型下首次对DD估计量与标准朴素TSR（TSRN）估计量进行了理论比较，证明了两个关键结果：(i) DD的偏差严格……
tldr: 提出双对角（DD）估计量，通过对比“处理-处理”与“控制-控制”配对结果并利用非对角交互校正干扰偏差，并在平均场市场模型下首次与朴素双边随机化估计量进行理论比较，为均衡市场条件下的双边市场实验提供更优的处理效应估计方法。
en_tdlr: The Double Diagonal (DD) estimator contrasts treated-treated and control-control pair outcomes while leveraging off-diagonal interactions to correct interference-induced bias, and provides the first theoretical comparison with the naive two-sided randomization estimator under a mean-field market model, offering a better approach for balanced two-sided marketplace experiments.
